meta.model: v3 discrete-time hazard (SPEC_V3.md), trained on classes 2007-2025
notes: Starter = a season with 10+ games of 10+ pass attempts, within 5 years of draft. Base rate ~48% of drafted QBs.
Out-of-sample (leave-one-draft-class-out): college-only AUC 0.733 [0.666-0.803], college+draft 0.894, draft position alone 0.887. Combined vs draft-only: statistical tie (DeLong p = 0.72).
Strongest college signals: age at draft, rushing share, completion %. Box-score EPA adds little beyond these.
Rookie-season performance is not predictable out-of-sample and is not projected.
